spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The mummy casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}, {@hit 9} to hit with spell attacks):

spellcasting.name: Dread Command
headerEntries: The mummy casts {@spell Command|SRD52} (level 2 version), using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. The mummy can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
entries: If the mummy fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The mummy has {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Undead Restoration
entries: If destroyed, the mummy gains a new body in 24 hours if its heart is intact, reviving with all its {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}. The new body appears in an unoccupied space within the mummy's lair. The heart is a Tiny object that has AC 17, HP 10, and {@variantrule Immunity|SRD52} to all damage except Fire.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mummy makes one Rotting Fist or Channel Negative Energy attack, and it uses Dreadful Glare.

action.name: Rotting Fist
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it is cursed. While cursed, the target can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}, it gains no benefit from finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52}, and its {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52|Hit Point} maximum decreases by 10 ({@dice 3d6}) every 24 hours that elapse. A creature dies and turns to dust if reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} by this attack.

action.name: Dreadful Glare
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 17}, one creature the mummy can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} 25 ({@damage 6d6 + 4}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Paralyzed|SRD52} condition until the end of the mummy's next turn.

reaction.name: Whirlwind of Sand
entries: {@actTrigger} The mummy is hit by an attack roll. {@actResponse} The mummy adds 2 to its AC against the attack, possibly causing the attack to miss, and the mummy teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Each creature of its choice that it can see within 5 feet of its destination space has the {@condition Blinded|SRD52} condition until the end of the mummy's next turn.

legendary.name: Glare
entries: The mummy uses Dreadful Glare. The mummy can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary.name: Necrotic Strike
entries: The mummy makes one Rotting Fist or Channel Negative Energy attack.

Those desperate to escape death sometimes make terrible bargains with wicked deities. Devoting their hearts to evil forces, these villains gain power over death and a cursed immortality that binds their minds and spirits within a desiccated corpse. Freed from mortal concerns, these mummy lords pursue their obsessions across ages.

Most mummy lords linger amid the ruins of ancient palaces or temples where they once held sway. Their age-old faith and ties to deathly forces grant them fearful magic, which they use to sow ruin and animate undead servants.

A mummy lord's heart embodies the pact that grants it immortality. Rather than bearing its heart within its corpse, a mummy lord removes and hides this accursed organ. As long as its heart isn't destroyed by fire, a mummy lord can return to unlife no matter what doom it meets.
Mummy lords are usually consumed by ageless plots. Roll on or choose a result from the Mummy Lord Plots table to determine a mummy lord's ancient agenda.

entries.caption: Mummy Lord Plots
rows: Open a portal to the past, when its power was at its height.
Perform a ritual that can be attempted only once every eight hundred years.
Reclaim and resurrect a loved one's corpse.
Reconquer the lands that once composed its empire.
Recover the pieces of its lost heart.
Replace its descendant as the ruler of a realm.
Sacrifice a thousand souls to its god in return for true life.
Transform the people of an entire nation into Undead servants.

entries.name: Mummy Lord Lairs
entries: Mummy lords typically lurk in the ruins of places they dwelled in life. Such sites have forbidding reputations, or they might be lost and forgotten.

The scroll contained a foul ritual to raise one of the children of Anhktepot. I tried to burn it, but the flames refused to touch the parchment. Forgive me, but I cannot destroy it... and I cannot help myself.
